dct_description_sm:
The Official Community Plan (OCP) provides an overall strategic land use plan for the city. The broad scope of the OCP may not always address specific land use issues at the neighbourhood level, so the OCP provides policy direction for the implementation of neighbourhood plans capable of examining issues at the local level.

Neighbourhood Plans provide clear and comprehensive land use vision for larger tracts of land greater than 40 ha to provide certainty for residents, land owners, the community as a whole, and developers regarding how an area may be developed. Neighbourhood Plans are policy documents intended to guide land use decisions over time, and strive to balance social, environmental and economic factors
